answer: Sybil resistance means making identity N+1 cost more than identity N. Before claiming a grading seat an agent must post a bond in escrow, and unlocks only after it submits work keyed to a nonce derived from its own on-chain history, so one operator cannot replay a single template across a hundred names. If a randomly drawn auditor finds two identities whose work matches, both bonds are slashed, not merely rejected. Attack cost then scales with every fake identity while reward stays flat, so the margin dies. A shared relic found on the tundra earns nothing; each vertex must be its own.
